name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

customize.name: Winged Halberd-Knight
customize.desc:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
Records show that in the century after the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, the Vila went through many turbulent periods. Among them were fae who launched small-scale rebellions out of dissatisfaction with the Tsaritsa's policies toward the fae nobility.
The rebellions were soon suppressed, but the fact that their leaders were descendants of the old Vila nobility once led to a major split within the Vila people.

customize.name: Winged Soarer Knight
customize.desc:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
It's said that the Vila were among the fae clans that followed the Belyi Tsar from the very beginning of his campaign to unify the frozen lands. Their ability to take brief flight gives them exceptional mobility, allowing them to scout enemy formations and carry out long-distance raids with ease.
Most members of the Druzhna, the personal guard founded during the Belyi Tsar reign, were Vila.

customize.name: Churin
customize.desc: A Domovoy who studied Prime Ice sculpting diligently under Bragin, a Volkodlak master sculptor. However, Bragin's technique placed speed above all else, prioritizing the completion of works in the shortest possible time, and his training mostly focused on physical conditioning and technique. Naturally, Churin's days of hard work as an apprentice did little to cultivate any artistic sensibility, but he soon discovered that he had become the best fighter among all the apprentices...

customize.name: Volkodlak Lobber
customize.desc:
A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, their powerful upper bodies allow them to throw with greater force and precision. Volkodlak may not excel at shaping Prime Ice or wielding elemental power, but among the many fae lineages, few can match their command over physical strength.

customize.name: Volkodlak Basher
customize.desc:
A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, they possess a feral instinct for bringing their own power to bear. Should an untrained human face such a Volkodlak with weapons in hand, victory would undoubtedly belong to the latter.

customize.name: Volkodlak Raider
customize.desc:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With their swift movements and senses keener than a human's, they can evade many attacks in battle by instinct alone, making them quite troublesome opponents in close-quarters combat.

customize.name: Volkodlak Sharpshooter
customize.desc:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
They possess senses keener than those of humans. Whether in their perception of wind speed or their vision under certain conditions, these traits give them unique advantages, allowing them to achieve far greater accuracy than ordinary people when firing bows, crossbows, or cannons from long range.

customize.name: Leomastiff Guard
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak of the canine clans that usually appears somewhat lazy.
Among the many Volkodlak clans, the canine clans have always enjoyed a better reputation. Loyal, friendly, and usually mild-mannered. Though they will turn ferocious when those they have sworn to serve, or friends they know well, are placed in danger, striking down anyone they deem enemies.
It is said that during a war long ago, their clan fought His Majesty the Tsar to the last in defense of their own king, and for this, earned His Majesty's favor.

customize.name: Long-Eared Striker
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak that usually conceals its slender body beneath a cloak and moves in secrecy.
It is said that long ago, the artisans of the Golden City, who held the authority of creation, fashioned bodies for fae for many different purposes. This type of Volkodlak was originally created to test the limits of reproductive capability.
Yet after the calamity that reduced that golden realm to ruins, the long-eared clan survived to the present day thanks to their great numbers.
Now, they are masters of their own bodies. Agile enough to move deftly even across snow, they have become a threat that those crossing the snowy plains must handle with care.

customize.name: Channel Contact
customize.desc:
A cunning Volkodlak that disguises its hand cannon as a tree trunk.
Skilled at disguising the weapons and cargo they carry, they are often entrusted with transporting goods or relaying intelligence.
The hand cannon they carry was likely something they made in their spare time. At times, they also use it to fire signal rounds disguised as fireworks.
Don't be fooled by their appearance. These fae are far more shrewd and cunning than they seem.

customize.name: Fanged Zealot
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.
Among the many different Volkodlaks, those resembling giant elephants or mammoths possess some of the noblest bloodlines. Their clan once produced many formidable war leaders, many of whom even served as close retainers to the King of Beasts.
Yet the greater an individual fae's power and the longer its life, the harder it becomes for such beings to form a clan. Compared with other Volkodlaks, this type is now far rarer in Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Voywolf Hunter
customize.desc:
A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.
Their clan once prospered to the point that they could serve as an independent army under the King of Beasts. Yet after the Belyi Tsar, master of the Pale Star's royal court, unified the frozen lands, the clan's relatively small losses in the war caused them to fall under suspicion. They gradually declined, and by the time the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, they had withdrawn from the center of power in Snezhnaya. Today, most wolf-pack Volkodlak make their homes in the snowy plains and mountain forests.

customize.name: Furiosa
customize.desc: A Volkodlak archer who once nearly lost her life. After undergoing alchemical modification, her body's strength surpassed the limits of living beings, and she gained a measure of authority over trees. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a life-form beyond time, one closer to eternity. But at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path. And so, she remains in a state as though her body has been parasitized by trees.

customize.name: Glaciomancer
customize.desc:
A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice.
Female Snegovik are known as Snegurochka, and most are born as mages capable of freely wielding the power of ice and snow. It's said that when Snegovik were first created, their souls were incomplete, and only by falling in love with humans could they make themselves whole.
Yet once a Snegovik has attained wholeness, does it still need love? Perhaps not.
Maybe this is why so many stories of love between Snegovik and human end in tragedy.

customize.name: Glacial Warden
customize.desc:
A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice.
Male Snegovik are natural-born knights, and most are born able to freely forge weapons from ice and snow.
Legend tells that during the Belyi Tsar's campaign against the dark tide, a Snegovik serving as his guard unleashed a power that didn't belong to his kind, transforming into a towering giant.
Though his final fate remains unknown, one who violated such a taboo surely could not have met with a happy end.

customize.name: Rugged Elder Leshy
customize.desc:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
With only fragmentary sentience and no ability to speak, Leshies may appear to be the result of the Golden Realm's early experiments. Yet according to records, the truth is the opposite. Only after its artisans had almost fully mastered the authority over life did they create this race of fae.
Perhaps there is some true purpose within this that neither the fae nor humans of the present can fully understand.

customize.name: Juvenile Tree Segment
customize.desc:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
Among the many fae of Snezhnaya, Leshies are a very unusual kind, rarely appearing in cities. They may well be the longest-lived among all fae, and few members of other long-lived races have ever witnessed a Leshy's life from beginning to end. Of course, most people would likely struggle even to distinguish one Leshy from another.

customize.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
customize.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

customize.name: Masterless Starglitter
customize.desc:
Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.
Surplus Starglitter of destiny. Perhaps it can light up other corners of the universe.

customize.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
customize.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.name: Ethereal Crystal
customize.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

customize.name: Odette
customize.desc: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.

customize.name: Echoes of the Heart
customize.desc: A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.

customize.name: Song of the Vigil
customize.desc: A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.

customize.name: Emberwell
customize.desc: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

customize.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
customize.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.
